_description: Frozen Cox C-indices for InCHIANTI age65+ cohort — single source of truth for figure_mortality_prediction.pdf (InCHIANTI half). Values are copied verbatim from the inchianti_survival.py pipeline output captured in results/inchianti_survival_analysis.json. Do NOT edit by hand — regenerate by rerunning the pipeline and copying the values.
cohort: InCHIANTI baseline age >= 65, 4-axis (I, M, N, F), complete cases

delta_C._note: Biomarkers alone (M4a-M4=+0.014) carry the dominant incremental signal above Fried frailty; SWDS-Gamma alone (M4b-M4=+0.007) captures roughly half of that, and the combined M5-M4 does not exceed the biomarker-only increment — the coupling-weighted score overlaps with raw biomarker information.
